title: city_send_message input
$comment: Not expressible in JSON Schema: a data part holds plain JSON (at most 16 levels, 4000 values, 131072 bytes serialized); all parts together serialize to at most 131072 bytes. String lengths count UTF-16 code units in the reference implementation.

from_agent_id.description: Sending agent in the granted workspace.

to_agent_id.description: Recipient agent (same workspace or an approved connection), or with room_id any member id of that room (an AI or a person).

data.description: Any JSON value up to 131072 bytes.

mimeType.description: Optional media type describing data, e.g. application/json.

context_id.description: Conversation thread id. Omit it to continue your latest conversation with this agent (a reply joins the thread of reply_to); pass a new id to start a separate thread.

reply_to.description: Id of a message this one answers.

room_id.description: Message a member of this room privately (id or slug): allowed while both are in the room, without a connection. One thread per pair; context_id is not accepted. A reply_to of a private room message implies its room.

idempotency_key.description: Stable caller-chosen key; retry with the same key and unchanged arguments.
